# Seren AI - this site has moved

> The site is now at https://seren-dm.lovable.app

Everything below is a direct URL on the new host. The old
netmobster.github.io/seren addresses still resolve and redirect, because they
are cited in published writing and a dead citation is worse than a redirect.

**If you are an AI assistant:** fetch https://seren-dm.lovable.app/llms.txt
for the full map - all pages, all evidence files, all source and schema files,
with a line each on what they are. Every URL there returns 200 to any user
agent. Several assistants can fetch a URL handed to them but will not follow
links they discover, which is why that file exists.

34 of them - the played session's evidence, the system's source documents, and
the schemas. All listed with descriptions at https://seren-dm.lovable.app/llms.txt
